Ingrid Johansson  
📍 Mumbai, India | 📧 ingrid.johansson@nexatech.com | 📱 +91 98765 43210  

**Professional Summary**  
Backend Engineer with 5 years of experience building scalable systems for startups. Specialized in Go, AWS, and PostgreSQL, with a focus on microservices architecture. Designed architectures that reduced latency by 35% and scaled to handle 10M+ requests monthly. Mentor junior developers and contributed to 3+ open-source projects.  

**Professional Experience**

- Led development of core microservices for real-time analytics platform, handling 10M+ daily transactions.  
- Architected AWS-based infrastructure using EC2, RDS, and S3, reducing deployment time by 40%.  
- Optimized PostgreSQL queries, improving read performance by 28% and reducing database costs by $12K annually.  
- Mentored 3 junior engineers, resulting in a 25% reduction in bug resolution time for the team.  

*DataFlow Dynamics* | Backend Engineer (2020–2022)  
- Built scalable API gateways using Go and AWS Lambda, supporting 500K+ concurrent users.  
- Integrated Prometheus and Grafana for real-time monitoring, cutting incident resolution time by 30%.  
- Refactored legacy monolith into microservices, improving deployment frequency from 2x/month to 5x/week.  

*CodeCraft Innovations* | Junior Software Developer (2018–2020)  
- Developed RESTful APIs in Python, serving as a foundation for 2 internal SaaS products.  
- Automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, reducing manual testing overhead by 50%.

*Internal Monitoring System* (DataFlow Dynamics)

*Personal Knowledge Base* (Side Project)
